locator: I q.3 a.7 co.: Tertio, quia omne compositum causam habet
interpretation: Third proof of God's simplicity: every composite has a cause, since things diverse in themselves do not come together into one except through a cause uniting them; God has no cause, being the first efficient cause. The uniting cause is read as a cause, other than the composite, of its being as one thing; that is the interpretive step.
